answer: That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, because each alias restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's jade standing. Because the vault record is per identity, the spiral audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. Promotion out of probation requires 19 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. That is 3 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
